issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside getSourceMap runs per stack frame with no caching.
issues.detail: getSourceMap fires per frame during error serialization, doing existsSync + readFileSync (plus a second read inside convert-source-map) every time. For stacks hitting the same external file repeatedly this is O(frames * fileSize) blocking I/O on a hot error path. Memoize by file path with a small Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes resolvedSources semantics with no documented precondition or unit test.
issues.detail: The fix reverses argument order and assumes `from` is always a file path so '..' strips the filename. If `from` is empty, a directory, or a URL, the result is wrong. The invariant is nowhere stated and the only evidence is a snapshot diff. Document the precondition on `from` and add a direct DecodedMap.resolvedSources unit test.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' for missing map files, silently masking failures.
issues.detail: When the referenced map file is absent, the reader returns the literal string '{}' so convert-source-map parses an empty but valid map. This conflates 'file missing', 'broken sourceMappingURL', and 'empty map', and lies to downstream consumers. Return undefined and let the caller decide, or at minimum log once at debug level.

issues.description: Heuristic `!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file)` as external-module discriminator is fragile and undocumented.
issues.detail: The predicate complects three concerns (module identity, transform state, filesystem existence) into folklore about how Vite represents externals. If Vite ever populates transformResult for an externalized module, source maps silently break. Extract an isExternalUntransformed(file) predicate and state the invariant Vite guarantees.

issues.description: Source-map helpers live in test-run.ts but belong with the source-map utilities.
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are stateless source-map transforms with nothing to do with TestRun orchestration. They belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts next to DecodedMap so the module boundary matches responsibility and the helpers are reusable and testable in isolation.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file invites Windows path-separator bugs.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' but the new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. pathe normalizes separators across platforms; node:path does not. On Windows the targetPath for sourceMappingURL resolution may diverge from the rest of Vitest's path handling. Use pathe consistently.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch fixes a real bug — external-module stack frames now get source-map resolution and the DecodedMap resolve() change matches the sourcemap spec — but the rigor lags the complexity. Three load-bearing concerns recur across all six reviewers: per-frame synchronous I/O with no caching, an undocumented and untested semantic shift in resolvedSources, and a '{}' fallback that silently masks malformed references. Secondary issues include a fragile externality heuristic, helpers placed in the wrong module, and inconsistent path libraries. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — cache the reads, document and unit-test the resolve() invariant, stop returning '{}', and tighten the external-module predicate before landing.
